subject: Private VPC deployment — econ targets & scope
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acadiahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-10T15:20:00-04:00
Subject: Private VPC deployment — econ targets & scope

Hi Sarah — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick written recap so we’re aligned and to keep momentum.

Call recap (high level)
- Primary use: clinical summarization and secure patient-facing chat behind Acadia’s VPC.
- Initial traffic: you mentioned 200–400M prompt+completion tokens / month, with a~3–4x peak when batch jobs run overnight.
- Roadmap: target ramp to ~1B tokens/month within 12 months if initial integration looks good.
- Environments: Prod + Staging + one isolated Preprod for vendor QA (3 isolated envs).
- Constraints: strict data residency, HSM-backed key management, SOC2 + upcoming HITRUST review.

Immediate qualification points we discussed for pricing:
1) Licensing model: are you leaning toward a pure usage model, or a hybrid (annual license for private control plane + per-token usage)? You said procurement prefers predictable fixed-cost buckets.
2) Token economics target: your finance team asked for a ballpark target in $/1M tokens to evaluate unit economics.
3) Support: likely need Premium (24/7 on-call + quarterly SRE reviews) but open to Standard during pilot.
4) Environments: want pricing per isolated VPC environment called out explicitly.

What I’m proposing as next steps (short):
- I’ll send a short pricing options summary (license + per-token ranges) and a worksheet for you to drop in your expected token profile (attached: redwood-private-pricing-template.xlsx).
- You’ll confirm which support tier and whether the Preprod environment must be full isolation (we discussed a lower-trust staging option).
- If numbers look good, we’ll follow with a tailored proposal and legal/Procurement introduction.

Ballpark (for discussion only) — based on what you told us:
- Option A (Hybrid, low commit): Annual private platform license $60,000 + $650 per 1M tokens.
- Option B (Reserved capacity, 12-month commit): Annual license $180,000 + $360 per 1M tokens (1B token commit).
- Add-on: each additional fully isolated private env: $25,000/year.
- Support: Standard included; Premium +20% of license fee (adds 24/7/1hr pager SLA, quarterly SRE reviews, on-call rotation).

Notes: these are preliminary ranges — I’ll refine with engineering on exact footprint assumptions (model family, quantization, expected sequence lengths) which materially impact cost.

Attached: redwood-private-pricing-template.xlsx — please drop your expected monthly token volumes and a few example sequence lengths and I’ll run a tailored unit economics view.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Vanessa — short answers below, appreciate the summary.

Volume clarification:
- Pilot (Q4): ~250M tokens/month.
- Post-pilot (12mo): plan for a staged ramp: 250M -> 600M -> ~1B tokens/month.
- Peak concurrency: expected bursts during business hours and end-of-day batch that could triple per-second demand for short windows.

Licensing preference:
- Procurement wants a predictable baseline. They like the idea of a reserved capacity option if the per-token economics are favorable. Open to hybrid if the committed discount is meaningful.

Environments:
- Prod and Staging must be fully isolated. The Preprod vendor QA environment can be lower isolation if you provide a tech assertion on how data is segmented — will confirm.

Support:
- Pilot: Standard OK. Long-term we want Premium (HITRUST + 24/7 ops readiness).

Two asks for your next pricing pass:
1) Show a 12-month ramp model with monthly token tiers and what our annual bill looks like in Option A vs Option B.
2) Please call out any one-time onboarding fees and approximate timeline for Private/VPC deployment (we’re thinking pilot start in Oct).

I’ve attached a short internal note (Acadia_MA-Requirements.pdf) that shows our compliance bullets — hope that helps.

Best,
Sarah Jenkins
Director, Digital Platforms | Acadia Health
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>

Sarah — perfect, thanks for the clarifications and the requirements doc, that’s very helpful. Attached is a quick follow-up worksheet populated with two ramp scenarios (low and baseline) and the dollars-at-annualized-scale for the two pricing approaches we sketched: hybrid and reserved. Summary below (rounded):

Scenario A — Baseline ramp (pilot 250M -> 600M -> 1B): annualized token volume ~7.2B tokens
- Hybrid (no commit): License $60k/year + $650 / 1M tokens -> ~ $4,800/month @ 600M -> annualizes to ~$58k on tokens + license = ~$118k/year (pilot-year blended higher due to ramp)
- Reserved (1B commit): License $180k/year + $360 / 1M tokens -> committed bucket pricing at scale produces ~ $2,592/month @ 600M equivalent rate if committed (note: math shown in attached sheet). Equivalent blended spend at 1B scale is substantially lower per-1M tokens.

Scenario B — Aggressive ramp (target full 1B sustained): annual token ~12B
- Hybrid becomes materially more expensive; reserved capacity shows ~30–45% cost savings at sustained scale.

Other items:
- One-time onboarding: engineering onboarding + VPC setup (incl. HSM/KMS integration) estimate $25k–$40k depending on complexity and required SSO/audit instrumentation. Typical timeline: 6–10 weeks from PO sign to pilot (includes security review, account provisioning, and model onboarding).
- Environments: Prod + Staging: included in license for base setup. Fully isolated Preprod: $25k/year if you require separate VPC and dedicated capacity.
- Support: Premium is license * 1.2 (adds 24/7, SLA, SRE reviews).

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll update the sheet to show a monthly ramp (per your ask) and attach a side-by-side annual total for Option A vs B.
2) If that looks decent, we’ll produce a draft SOW + proposal for Procurement.
3) Marissa — can we get a quick engineering feasibility check on HSM integration and an estimate of time to provision a dedicated Preprod env?

Happy to hop on a 30-min follow-up with Tom and your procurement folks next week if that helps.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- Account: Acadia Health (ACD-2026-071). Pilot volumes: 250M rising to ~1B tokens/mo in 12 months. Environments: Prod + Staging (full isolation) + Preprod (likely isolated).
- They want predictable baseline; procurement prefers reserved commit if per-token discount is >~40%.

Pricing ask:
- I’m proposing to offer the Reserved option at the numbers I shared: License $180k + $360 / 1M tokens with a 1B token 12-month commit. That yields healthy CA growth and predictable revenue.
- If Procurement pushes back on license, I can offer up to a 15% concession on the license fee but would like to hold the per-token rate at $360 for commit economics. Any more than 15% needs leadership approval.

Operational asks:

- Rishi: if we want to push to 20% concession to close faster, I need a quick margin check vs expected net unit economics at 1B commit.

Timeline: they want pilot in Oct. Need signed PO by end of Sept to hit that timeline.

Thanks — I’ll hold a short sync if you want to go through the numbers.

Vanessa
